podcast.body: This iconic punk rock song features one of the most famous one-note guitar solos in punk history. However, this elegant solo was not played by Johnny Ramone, but by the album's producer, Ed Stasium, who also contributed a muted rhythm part with his Fender Stratocaster to build up the thick guitar layers on the track.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was one source of a "fairly steady stream of royalty checks" for Joey Ramone, contributing to his income. "Sure there was a fairly steady stream of royalty checks from a couple of songs like I want to be sedated..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
